hook.name: MikoFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a 400 bps protocol fee on the native ETH side of all native/ERC-20 pool swaps, collected via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas and sent to an immutable fee treasury. During a configurable launch window (default 720 seconds), an exponentially-decaying anti-sniping surcharge (default starting at 6000 bps, tau=158s) and per-swap/per-wallet token amount caps are enforced.
